ranked.headline: Learned models for histopathology, spatial transcriptomics and survival prediction
ranked.summary: Learned representations from histology, spatial transcriptomics and LLMs are now assessed against explicit biological and clinical reference criteria.

ranked.headline: Machine learning on omics pairs biological priors with leakage-free validation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark ML across omics and histology modalities while stressing leakage-free validation and interpretability.

ranked.headline: Benchmark splits and leakage challenge reported generalization in molecular prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints audit leakage, cross-validation splits and benchmark construction to test whether reported performance survives realistic conditions.

ranked.headline: Reproducible tools for chromatin, long-read and short-read sequencing analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release automated pipelines and benchmarks for sequencing analyses that standard workflows handle poorly.

ranked.headline: Calibrating imputed spatial expression and spatial association for valid inference
ranked.summary: Imputed and disjoint-coordinate spatial data demand inference procedures that account for reconstruction error and spatial autocorrelation.

ranked.headline: ML models predict antigen recognition across TCR, pMHC, and antibody-epitope binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair protein language models with similarity-aware splits and host-wise evaluation to test whether antigen recognition predictors generalize.

ranked.headline: Bioinformatic analyses of protein databases, repeats, and structural geometry
ranked.summary: Growth-curve modeling of PDB and fold counts, plus proteome repeat and structural-geometry tools, quantify protein-universe expansion and sequence complexity.

ranked.headline: Structured latent embeddings for multi-omics, imaging and single-cell perturbation data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published multi-omics VAE apply task-specific priors, fusion, and contrastive objectives to heterogeneous biological embeddings.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map transient binding pockets and persistent ligand contacts in proteins
ranked.summary: Recent MD studies target transient protein states, from Rac1 surface pockets to GPCR activation transitions and retinol-binding protein 1 contact persistence.

ranked.headline: Reduced-resolution models make protein and RNA ensemble sampling tractable
ranked.summary: Physics-based, coarse-grained, and generative models now produce conformational ensembles that are checked against experimental measurements.

ranked.headline: Validating computational pipelines for microbiome and bacterial genomic inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark differential abundance methods and release Nanopore and Snakemake workflows for microbiome and bacterial genomics.

ranked.headline: Computational tools link mass spectra, gene-protein rules, and metabolic models
ranked.summary: Four preprints automate annotation and model reconstruction, from spectral interpretation to gene-protein rules and curated human metabolic models.

ranked.headline: Sequence models gain from text, graph, and topological context for biological prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs pretrained biological language models with text, graph, or topological inputs across proteins, RNA, DNA, and mass spectra.

ranked.headline: Explicit structural constraints guide spatial transcriptomics and 3D cell reconstruction
ranked.summary: Time-series and spatial transcriptomics datasets require methods that preserve tissue geometry and contiguous structure across slices and time points.

ranked.headline: Decomposed Binding Energetics and Hybrid Force Fields for Drug-Like Molecules
ranked.summary: Decomposed binding free energy terms are being scrutinized for collinearity and interpretability as physics-based and hybrid ML methods expand.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models and screens resolve pathogen regulation, fitness and transcription
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and Bayesian models are now paired with sparse or noisy experimental data across viral, parasitic and in vitro systems.

ranked.headline: Constraint-driven generative models for drug-like molecules and protein binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend constrained generation to 3D diffusion, fragment grammars, and peptide-interface targeting.

ranked.headline: Open and agentic pipelines for de novo protein and antibody binder design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a Nature paper report zero-shot and open-source binder design pipelines with improved hit rates and developability.

ranked.headline: AI agents tested on single-cell, genomics, and published-study reproduction tasks
ranked.summary: Agents are now judged on verifiable long-horizon analyses and published-study reproductions, exposing hallucination and run-to-run variance.

ranked.headline: Lineage-tracing and stochastic models link clonal dynamics to single-cell expression
ranked.summary: Lineage tracing at single-cell resolution now pairs with probabilistic models of expression dynamics on lineage trees in development and aging.

ranked.headline: Multiancestry eQTL mapping and deep sequence models refine regulatory variant prediction
ranked.summary: Multiancestry eQTL resources now allow deep sequence models to be benchmarked against fine-mapped causal regulatory variants across populations.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links regulatory divergence to lineage-specific duplications
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies paired with single-cell and chromatin profiling now resolve regulatory divergence across fish, carp, and ungulate lineages.

ranked.headline: Annotation-free expressed region detection and read resampling for RNA-seq data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints present annotation-free transcript detection, scalable FASTQ resampling, and refined yeast UTR annotation from direct RNA sequencing.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for automated biomedical image and enrichment-data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases describe open-source tools for assay quantification, enrichment visualization, and imaging proteomics analysis.

ranked.headline: Auditing error rates and prior bias in deep learning de novo peptide sequencing
ranked.summary: Deep learning de novo sequencing predictions require calibrated error estimates and bias audits before their peptide identifications can be trusted.

ranked.headline: Nucleosome spacing and RNA binding set chromatin and RNP condensate phase behavior
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained models now couple heterogeneity, active remodeling and binding saturation directly to chromatin and RNP phase behavior.

ranked.headline: Context-aware reanalysis and phenotype-to-cell mapping advance rare disease genomics
ranked.summary: Automated iterative reanalysis and single-cell phenome mapping now reach thousands of rare diseases, alongside a forward-time genotype simulator.

ranked.headline: Prior-informed inference of cis-regulatory and dynamic regulatory network structure
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous omics and dynamic network data now support prior-informed models of regulatory architecture and rewiring over time.

ranked.headline: Structure predictors embedded in iterative loops to guide protein sequence design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple structure prediction to binder and protein design loops, and package design pipelines for broader accessibility.

ranked.headline: Functional assays and models localize coding and noncoding variant effects
ranked.summary: Experimental and large-scale datasets now resolve variant effects at residue, UTR, and alternate-decoding levels, moving beyond sequence-based prediction alone.

ranked.headline: Assemblies for a tapeworm, a lobster, and 816 vertebrates extend non-model genomics
ranked.summary: Long-read and community-scale assemblies now cover parasitic, crustacean, and vertebrate taxa, with one assembly yielding an applied sexing marker.

ranked.headline: Locus-resolved mapping of chromatin and regulatory features across human genomes
ranked.summary: Haplotype-aware methods and standardized reference resources now resolve regulatory and chromatin features at individual loci and across reference epigenomes.

ranked.headline: Wiring Structure Shapes Emergent Dynamics in Modeled Cortical Networks
ranked.summary: Measured and specified wiring motifs are now being linked directly to emergent network dynamics in cortical models.

ranked.headline: Simulated evolutionary ground truth tests recovery of ancestors and intermediates
ranked.summary: Two 2026 preprints benchmark ancestral and intermediate inference against simulated evolutionary truth, testing coupling-aware reconstruction.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale metabolic models are being reconstructed and interrogated computationally
ranked.summary: New reconstruction tools and minimal-pathway methods extend metabolic modeling to microbial communities and auxotroph design.

ranked.headline: Molecular dynamics probes receptor assembly and conformational variability
ranked.summary: Full-length membrane receptor and viral glycoprotein assemblies are now modeled by MD in explicit membrane and multiscale contexts.

ranked.headline: Pooled populations distort transcriptomic correlations and co-expression network structure
ranked.summary: Gene relationships from pooled data and foundation-model embeddings are being tested for context dependence across bulk and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free phylogeny and consensus annotation tools for microbial genomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints combine alignment-free inference, consensus annotation and start-codon quantification to refine microbial genome analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep image embeddings as endophenotypes for genome-wide association studies
ranked.summary: Learned imaging representations now yield heritable endophenotypes at biobank scale, enabling GWAS of cortical, cardiac and canine traits.
